answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 66 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the forge log reveals the live set and the violet audit records each lapse. Keeping 107 aliases alive therefore means 107 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the copper quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
